# old-invocation-allowlist.txt — files that may still name a shim script of the install, manage
# and link entry points (spec 0255 R30, R32). scripts/tests/install-references.test.ts fails on
# any other tracked or untracked text file that names one of the thirteen shell scripts. The
# scripts are forwarding shims now: the instruction is `node scripts/<name>.ts` (or the Taskfile).
#
# Format: one repo-relative path per line; an entry ending in `/` covers every file below that
# directory. Every entry carries a reason as the `#` comment line directly above it. An entry
# that no longer matches a file with a hit, or that appears twice, fails the suite.

# This file: it lists the shim paths it allows.
scripts/tests/fixtures/install/old-invocation-allowlist.txt

# The thirteen shims themselves: each header and usage text names the invocation it keeps working.
scripts/install-extension.sh
scripts/install-extension-all.sh
scripts/install-claude-plugin.sh
scripts/install-copilot-plugin.sh
scripts/install-antigravity-extension.sh
scripts/install-workspace.sh
scripts/manage-claude-component.sh
scripts/manage-copilot-component.sh
scripts/manage-antigravity-component.sh
scripts/manage-workspace-component.sh
scripts/link-extensions.sh
scripts/unlink-extensions.sh
scripts/unlink-component.sh

# The shell allowlist and the CI path filters name the shim FILE PATHS (a change to a shim must
# select the jobs that run it); none runs one. The install-references suite checks separately
# that no CI configuration or Taskfile line runs a shim through `bash`.
ci/shell-allowlist.txt

.github/workflows/build.yml

# Shell scripts that remain until their own migration row and comment on the shim path.
scripts/release-package-extension.sh

scripts/lib/extension-targets.json
scripts/lib/extension-percli-keys.json

# The TypeScript modules cite the shell script each one twins ("ported from ...") in their header.
scripts/lib/install/
